annotations.title: See which AI bots a website lets in

description: Use when the user asks whether their site (or any public site), or a robots.txt they pasted, blocks ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Perplexity or other AI crawlers, whether AI can read or train on their content, or why AI search does not mention their site. Fetches the live robots.txt and reports, for 22 named AI bots in four groups (AI training, AI search, assistants, search engines), which are let in, kept out or partly blocked, plus the site's content-signal preference and fixes. Example: {"url": "example.com"} or {"robots_txt": "User-agent: GPTBot\nDisallow: /"}. Pass robots_txt instead of url to check a draft or pasted file without fetching anything. Read-only.

robots_txt.description: robots.txt text to check instead of fetching a site (a draft or a pasted file, up to 512 KB). Empty means no robots.txt.

url.description: Website address or domain, e.g. nytimes.com. Send this or robots_txt.
